description: Overpass Turbo is a data resource listed in Urban and Regional Planning Resources (APA Technology Division), a curated directory of planning data, software and learning resources under the section "Public Data Resources > OpenStreetMap", published or maintained by as named on overpass-turbo.eu. A web-based data mining tool for OpenStreetMap. It runs any kind of Overpass API query, shows the results on an interactive map, and allows users to export query data in the form of GeoJSON files (which may be converted to Shapefiles).
